title: Quentin and the Sigil
premise: Vesper Blackwood flees the magic-dead valley of Hollowmere only after the border wards collapse and the stars vanish, revealing that the valley's 'safety' was a prison built on a stolen sigil — the same sigil now burning in his blood, placed there by his dying mentor. Hunted by the Crown's wardens and shadowed by an exiled knight and a disgraced star-priest who become his unlikely family, Vesper learns the ancient war never ended; it was merely paused by the valley's theft of the sky. In the end, Vesper must choose between destroying the sigil to restore the stars at the cost of his own life-force, or keeping it and dooming the world — and he finds a third path: returning the sigil to the sky through the found family who help him bear its price together.
about_author: Marguerite Nystrom is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval grimoires before turning to fiction full-time. She writes fantasy about reluctant heroes and the quiet violence of survival from a farmhouse overlooking a valley she refuses to name.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. On the night the wards fail and the sky goes black, Vesper's mentor Maerlin dies pressing a burning sigil into his palm, whispering 'carry it home.' Wardens breach the valley hunting the sigil-bearer. Vesper flees through the dead border he was always forbidden to cross. Emotional beat: terror and grief fusing into resolve — invisibility is over.

chapters.title: A Knight Without a Banner
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV, with interludes from warden-captain Serah Dain. Hunted through the lowlands, Vesper is saved by Cassian, an exiled knight stripped of rank for refusing an unjust order, and Ivetta, a star-priest who felt the sky go dark. The sigil begins rewriting Vesper's veins in silver. Emotional beat: wary strangers becoming something like trust.

chapters.title: What the Valley Stole
chapters.summary: Ivetta's POV as the trio reaches the ruined Skyhold observatory and learns the truth: Hollowmere's founders stole the sigil from the heavens to end the old war, blinding the stars and caging generations. Serah corners them; Cassian offers his life for Vesper's escape. Emotional beat: fury at inherited sins, and the crushing weight of a price Vesper alone seems fated to pay.

chapters.title: The Price, Shared
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. At the shattered sky-altar, Vesper attempts the return alone and begins to burn out — until Cassian, wounded but alive, and Ivetta join hands with him, splitting the sigil's cost three ways. The stars reignite; the war's embers cool into memory. Serah, seeing the truth, lets them go. Emotional beat: survival redefined — not escaping the price, but refusing to pay it alone.
